title: A — TYPED REGISTRY AND PURE ISSUANCE
outcome: A — TYPED REGISTRY AND PURE ISSUANCE
acceptance: A — TYPED REGISTRY AND PURE ISSUANCE, cap +500 production. Depends on none. Add local/asserted/principal/scope types, versioned registry value representation, new-id generation, current/history resolution and validation, tombstones and separate HostReader identity. No production issuance, migration, wire switch or restore call. Registry storage/load hooks belong to B. Acceptance subset: I2 pure generation/format/equal-counter/rollback witnesses; I6 duplicate/current-versus-history/local-id type distinction; I7 no activation. Tests prove unknown versions, duplicates and broken ownership cannot produce a current scope.
